# Claude Live Scores

> A Claude Code mod: live football scores for the top 5 European leagues and national-team competitions in a pane, animated goal, red-card and VAR moments, and Claude mascots in the live match's kits playing a kickabout above the prompt. Scores come from ESPN's public scoreboard feed; no account or API key.

Install:
  claude plugin marketplace add thickiran/claude-live-scores
  claude plugin install live-scores@claude-live-scores
Then start a new session. /scores opens the pane, /scores pitch toggles the mascot pitch, /scores demo plays a scripted match.

- [README](https://github.com/thickiran/claude-live-scores/blob/main/README.md): what it does, commands, data source
- [Plugin README](https://github.com/thickiran/claude-live-scores/blob/main/plugins/live-scores/README.md): every hook, program and host, and what it stores
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/thickiran/claude-live-scores/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repo map, architecture, rules, how to add competitions
